text:
ellie-cs: Heads up — onboarding health check for NovaQuant. We've seen a steady rise in tail latency and cost per 1k tokens over the last 48h. Renewal conversation scheduled in 10 days; want to propose a short mitigation plan: dynamic-priority reroute + safe int8 fallback + brief canary. Looking for eng owners and quick alignment. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt-eng: Thanks. Can you paste the top-line metrics? My initial thought: shift a portion of traffic to the smaller quantized variant and enforce a soft TTL on the KV cache to reduce cold-cache p99s. If quality delta is acceptable we can keep routed share lower initially (10-20%).

ellie-cs: Quick snapshot: p50 stable, p95 +120ms, p99 +320ms. Cost per inference up ~22% week-over-week. Traffic is mostly inference-heavy for customer features (batch and streamed requests).

kim-ml: Important: int8 can reduce cost/latency but introduce subtle generation drift on long-context prompts. Recommend an inline eval set of ~50 representative prompts from their production corpus and compare top-5 metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity + hallucination checks) before widening traffic. I can prep that today.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Detected unusual increase in p99 latency for model: novaquant-v2 (hosted) after 2026-03-20T02:14:22Z. Alerts sent to #eng-runtime.

stephen-sre: For canary we should gate by both p99 and error-rate. If p99 improves by >100ms and error-rate <= baseline+0.2%, keep. Otherwise automatic rollback. Also want a rollback window of 15m if anomalies spike.

jordan_nova: hey team — we've noticed the slowness on our side. Appreciate any quick wins. Renewal team flagged this as a concern but not yet critical. Timeline wise, a few days of improvements would help our execs breathe.

matt-eng: Proposed tactical plan (short):
1) Immediate: add routing policy that weights 15% to novaquant-v2-int8 (quantized compatible variant) and 85% to current model. TTL cache tweak: set prefix KV TTL to 30s for longest-tail endpoints.
2) 1-2 day canary: capture eval set, compare lat/cost/quality.
3) If good, ramp 15->50% over 48h with rollback checks.

Sample routing policy we can push (will validate model compatibility first):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"model": "novaquant-v2-int8", "weight": 15, "compatibility_checks": ["kv_type", "max_seq"]},
    {"model": "novaquant-v2", "weight": 85}
  ],
  "rollback": {"p99_delta_ms": 100, "error_rate_delta": 0.002, "window_sec": 900}
}
```

sam-devex: I can prepare the SDK snippet and a small runbook for CS to toggle traffic if needed. Also will create a dev namespace canary first so devs can poke without affecting prod.

kim-ml: I'll assemble the eval set and run a diff against the current baseline. Planning to include long multi-turn prompts and a sample of the prompt prefixes that caused cache churn. Should have initial metrics in ~6-8 hours.

stephen-sre: Add me as watcher on the canary alerts. I'll set SLO guardrails and quick rollback automation. Also suggest we add a read-only dashboard for the renewal team with p50/p95/p99 and cost-per-1k to show progress.

ellie-cs: Action items recap:
- matt-eng: push initial routing policy to canary + KV TTL tweak (owner).
- kim-ml: eval set + quality diff (owner).
- sam-devex: SDK snippet + runbook + dev namespace canary (owner).
- stephen-sre: SLO guards + rollback automation + dashboard (owner).
- ellie-cs: coordinate with Nova execs and update renewal brief after 48h.

jordan_nova: Thanks — timeline works for us. If we see early wins can you prioritize a short executive note we can share? Even a 1-paragraph explanation of mitigations + expected impact would be great.

matt-eng: Will push canary policy in the next 2h and post a follow-up here with the deploy link. If pressure looks worse we can also temporarily route low-priority batch jobs to a cheaper model pool.

ellie-cs: Great—leave the channel for status. I'll schedule a 30-min check-in 48h from now and include renewal stakeholders. :calendar: 

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: from jordan_nova, :eyes: from kim-ml, :rocket: from matt-eng)
